chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Abī Wallād, from Abī Maryam, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was brought a man who had struck a pregnant woman with the pole of a tent and killed her. So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم gave her heirs the choice: either they take the diyah of five thousand dirhams and a ghurrah— a male or female servant— for the one in her womb, or they pay five thousand to the heirs of the killer and kill him.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءَهَا: The heirs or legal guardians of the slain woman
key_terms.الدِّيَةَ: Financial blood-compensation owed for unlawful killing
key_terms.الْقَاتِلِ: The killer whose case is being judged
key_terms.حَامِلًا: Pregnant; describing the woman who was struck
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, who issued the ruling in this case
key_terms.غُرَّةَ: Compensation for the fetus in the form of a servant, male or female

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills a pregnant woman and her fetus?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a man who killed a pregnant woman, including compensation for both the woman and the fetus. It shows that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم gave the victim's heirs a choice between taking diyah or pursuing retaliation under specified financial conditions.
